answer_1.quote: Given user instructions x ∈ X (e.g., "Generate a definition for artificial intelligence"), we aim to develop a model πθ that generates high-quality responses y ∼ πθ(y|x) as judged by some latent reward model. ... We run experiments on the instruction following task, which remains a challenging task for the strongest LLMs today.
answer_1.outputs: Generated instruction-following responses y for each user instruction x, evaluated for quality via a reward model and preference judgments.

answer_2.quote: We use win-rate to evaluate the performance of an LLM πθ, i.e., the percentage of times πθ is preferred to a reference model πref for their instruction-following outputs.

answer_3.quote: We use simulated win-rate to evaluate methods trained on simulated Dsim with simulated annotators by prompting API LLMs. ... ChatGPT uses OpenAI API LLM gpt-3.5-turbo-0301; GPT-4 uses OpenAI API LLM gpt-4-0314.
methods: pairwise preference labeling via prompting LLMs

answer_4.quote: We use human win-rate to evaluate methods trained on human Dhuman with human annotators. ... Human preference collecting: The first step is to produce pairs of responses ... which are then presented to humans who express preferences for each response.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are shown pairs of model-generated responses for the same instruction and asked to indicate which response is preferred.
